title: First component after two second-component extractions
statement: For a Boolean list $D$, define the result by extracting the second component of $D$, then the first component of that result, after first extracting the second component of $D$ once. Equivalently, apply second-component extraction to $D$, then second-component extraction again, and finally first-component extraction.
caveat: The supplied material does not define the component-extraction operations or the encoding.
